design_rule: Each reviewed mechanism has one representative and one single-variable control. No window-lag grid is permitted.

variants.readiness: Two-sided ordered book with at least three valid levels per side and enough depth to consume q. At 09:26, otherwise NaN with auction_book_unavailable.
variants.falsification: If the cross-sectional direction is unstable under the single shock-size control or collapses after spread and depth controls, reject the fragility mechanism.
variants.novelty_claim: Representative nonlinear counterfactual depth-consumption cost; it is not displayed-volume imbalance.

variants.readiness: Same as the representative, except both sides must cover the 0.25 depth shock. At 09:26, otherwise NaN.
variants.falsification: Systematically opposite ranks between shock10 and shock25 imply arbitrary scale dependence rather than robust depth fragility.
variants.novelty_claim: Single-variable control changing only shock_fraction from 0.10 to 0.25.

variants.readiness: At least 20 distinct exact TradePairResolved events; aggressor_source=BsFlag; both original quantities positive; estimated, Unknown and fallback pairs are diagnostics only.
variants.falsification: If the equal-pair control removes the structure, interpret it as large-trade exposure rather than parent-size mismatch.
variants.novelty_claim: Representative same-trade comparison of both parent-order sizes, weighted by executed volume.

variants.readiness: Identical exact-pair quality and sample requirements to the representative.
variants.falsification: Disagreement with the volume-weighted representative identifies trade-size exposure and blocks a parent-size interpretation.
variants.novelty_claim: Single-variable control changing only pair weighting from trade volume to equal weight.

variants.readiness: Valid two-sided spread and at least two exact active resting orders per side inside the current ten-level price band; denominator positive.
variants.falsification: If removing age has no stable effect or a few extreme-age orders dominate, survival time adds no commitment information.
variants.novelty_claim: Representative current commitment combines remaining quantity, price proximity and realized survival age.

variants.readiness: Identical exact active-order, quote-band and denominator requirements to the representative.
variants.falsification: No difference from the age-weighted representative means the result is remaining-depth imbalance, not survival commitment.
variants.novelty_claim: Single-variable control changing only age_weight from log1p(age/10) to one.

variants.readiness: Trailing 15 elapsed minutes contain positive exact cancellation volume and BsFlag execution volume; cumulative cancelled_qty is differenced per order; estimated and fallback activity is diagnostic only.
variants.falsification: No incremental cross-sectional structure after controlling both channel totals rejects cancellation-execution divergence.
variants.novelty_claim: Representative separates liquidity withdrawal from realized aggressive execution and normalizes each channel independently.

variants.readiness: Identical elapsed-window, exact-event and quality requirements to the representative.
variants.falsification: A result existing only under separate normalization flags low-activity denominator amplification for review.
variants.novelty_claim: Single-variable control changing only normalization from separate channel denominators to joint activity.

variants.readiness: At least 30 prior exact BsFlag trade pairs and one shock whose full 30-second response horizon has elapsed; valid pre-shock opposite L1 depth; exact additions only.
variants.falsification: Instability across shock sizes or domination by a few additions rejects replenishment per shock size as a recovery scale.
variants.novelty_claim: Representative explicitly detects a causal execution shock before measuring exact order replenishment.

variants.readiness: Same matured shock set as the representative, with valid consumed-side quote snapshots immediately after shock and at 30 seconds.
variants.falsification: Systematic disagreement with exact order additions requires attribution to cancellation, execution or level migration and blocks a recovery claim.
variants.novelty_claim: Single-variable control changing only recovery measurement from exact additions to visible depth recovery.

variants.readiness: At least 30 prior distinct exact BsFlag aggressor parents and a current same-side run containing at least two distinct parents; Unknown, estimated and fallback events are diagnostic only.
variants.falsification: If deduplication removes the run or the Markov score equals simple signed counts, independent-demand aggregation is unsupported.
variants.novelty_claim: Representative uses a causal first-order transition null after parent-order deduplication.

variants.readiness: Identical exact-parent history, current-run and quality requirements to the representative.
variants.falsification: No difference from the Markov representative means the preceding parent direction adds no state information.
variants.novelty_claim: Single-variable control changing only the probability model from first-order Markov to marginal Bernoulli.
